'''Frenk''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the planet [[Gorobei/Legends|Gorobei]]. The species had an armed force called the [[Frenk military]], of which [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]] may have been a former member.

==Biology and appearance==
The Frenk were a tall species, with most members reaching heights above 2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. They had red or green skin and four nostrils set upon a narrow snout and had four fingers on each hand, with the one next to the thumb being the larger. All known members of this species were very agile and fast.

==History==
[[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]], a member of the species, was a female [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was a fellow friend to [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] bounty hunter [[Sugi (bounty hunter)/Legends|Sugi]].

Another hunter by the name of [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], was part of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy's]] [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|plan]] to kidnap [[Palpatine/Legends|the Chancellor]].
